notes.title: Glimpse of WindSoul Soundtrack
notes.content:
I am proud to announce the beginning of official cooperation with the wonderful composer Vincent Black OST, who decided to write an exclusive soundtrack for "WindSoul" project.

Writing a soundtrack for this project is, in fact, a non-trivial task, music should not only pay attention to the atmosphere but also emphasize the visual style and charm of the game. And it seems that the new composer deals with these tasks just perfectly!

Today we are ready to present you one of the compositions:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GjgU1tmP6TA]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29020945/3a1dda712c24aaa2814c46dfc87acb9f6d0c5c87.png[/img]
[/url]

2017. INT-Works.
